pitch:
# A booking page for a hair salon

## 1. People and their journey

**Client** (the only role in the interface). Wants to see what the salon offers, find a free time and book without phoning.

Path: arrives on the page, picks a service, picks a day, picks a free time slot, enters name, phone and email, submits, and sees a confirmation message with the booking summary and its status.

Salon staff, who confirm requested bookings, are outside the interface and have no screens here.

## 2. How it looks

A single-column, light, friendly booking form in the style of a simple appointment scheduler, with numbered steps stacked top to bottom.

- **Page background**: flat warm off-white (#FAF6F1), full width, content centred in a 640px column.
- **Header**: top of the column, flat; salon-style title "A booking page for a hair salon" in deep charcoal (#2B2B2B) with a one-line subtitle in grey (#6B6B6B).
- **Step 1 heading "Choose a service"**: charcoal text with a plum (#7A3E65) number badge.
- **Service cards**: a vertical list, white, outlined in light grey (#DDD3CA), showing service name and duration in minutes. Hover: outline turns plum. Selected: plum outline, pale plum fill (#F3E6EE), plum tick at right.
- **Step 2 heading "Choose a day"**: same style, shown greyed (#B5ADA6) until a service is selected.
- **Day strip**: a row of the next 14 days, scrolling sideways; each day is a white outlined chip with weekday and date. Selected: plum fill, white text. Closed or fully booked days: grey text, striped-free flat grey fill (#EEE9E4), not pressable.
- **Step 3 heading "Choose a time"**: same style, greyed until a day is chosen.
- **Time slot grid**: three columns of small white outlined buttons showing start times. Selected: plum fill, white text. Taken or too short for the service: grey fill, struck-through text, not pressable.
- **No-times message**: grey text in place of the grid when a day has no free slot.
- **Step 4 heading "Your details"**: same style, greyed until a slot is chosen.
- **Details form**: fields for name, phone and email, white, outlined grey, labelled above. Focus: plum outline. Error: red (#B3261E) outline with red message below.
- **Booking summary**: pale plum flat box above the button showing service, day, time and duration.
- **Book button**: full width, flat plum with white text, "Request booking". Pressed: darker plum (#5E2E4D). Disabled until all is valid: grey (#CFC7C0). While sending: label "Sending…".
- **Confirmation panel**: replaces the form; white, raised with soft shadow, green (#2E7D4F) tick, summary, and a status pill "Requested" (amber #C77D00 fill) or "Confirmed" (green fill).
- **Failure banner**: red-tinted strip above the button when submission fails, with the message.

## 3. How it is used

- Click or tap a service card: selects it and enables day choice; tapping another switches the choice.
- Click or tap a day chip: selects it and loads that day's slots; swipe or scroll the strip sideways.
- Click or tap a free time slot: selects it; tapping another switches the choice.
- Type in name, phone and email: fields validate when left.
- Click or tap "Request booking": submits and shows the confirmation panel.
- Click or tap "Book another" on the confirmation: returns to an empty step 1.
- Click or tap a step heading already completed: scrolls back to it for changing.

## 4. Scope

One loop: choose service, day and time, give contact details, submit, see the confirmation. Staff, stylist choice, payments, products and loyalty are excluded. The form asks only for name, phone and email.

## 5. Things and their states

- **Service**: name, duration in minutes. Fixed.
- **Time slot**: date, start time. States: free → taken (when a booking is made on it); stays taken.
- **Booking**: service, slot, client name, phone, email. States: requested (on submit) → confirmed (by salon staff, outside the interface).

## 6. Rules

- A service must be chosen before a day; otherwise day and time stay disabled.
- A day must be chosen before a time; likewise.
- Changing the service clears the chosen time, since durations differ.
- A slot is offered only if the whole service duration fits before closing and before any taken slot.
- Taken slots cannot be selected; presses are ignored.
- Days in the past are not shown.
- Name is required, at most 80 characters.
- Phone is required, digits, spaces, + and - only, 7–15 digits.
- Email is required and must be a valid address.
- Invalid fields block submission and show a red message.
- If the slot was taken meanwhile, submission is refused, the slot greys out, and the client is asked to pick another time; details are kept.
- A new booking starts as requested.
- Only one booking per slot; a double submit creates one booking.
- A confirmed status is shown as it stands; clients cannot change it.
domain_name: A booking page for a hair salon
entities_block:
- **Service** (shown to audience: its records are loaded from the API): [id: string, name: string, duration_minutes: int]
- **TimeSlot** (shown to audience: its records are loaded from the API): [id: string, slot_date: datetime, start_time: datetime, status: string]
- **Booking** (created by audience): [id: string, service_id: string, time_slot_id: string, client_name: string, client_phone: string, client_email: string, status: string, created_at: datetime]
action_protocol_block:
The rules the product enforces (plan the audience's side of them; the business's own back-office handling is out of view):
- [Service card shows name and duration] (Service): Given the client is on step 1 When the service list is displayed Then each card shows the service name and duration in minutes
- [Service must be chosen before a day] (Booking): Given no service is selected When the client views step 2 Then the day strip is disabled and no day can be pressed
- [Day step greyed until service selected] (Service): Given no service is selected When step 2 is displayed Then its heading and day strip appear greyed out
- [Selecting a service enables day choice] (Booking): Given service A is selected When the client taps service B Then service B becomes the selected service and day choice remains enabled
- [Changing service clears chosen time] (Booking): Given a service and a time slot are selected When the client selects a different service Then the chosen time slot is cleared
- [Selected service card visual state] (Service): Given the service list is displayed When a card is hovered or selected Then it shows the plum outline and, if selected, the pale plum fill and plum tick
- [Day must be chosen before time] (TimeSlot): Given no day is selected When the client views step 3 Then the time grid is disabled and no slot can be pressed
- [Day strip covers next 14 days] (TimeSlot): Given the client opens the day strip When it is rendered Then it shows exactly the next 14 days as scrollable chips with weekday and date
- [Choosing a day loads its slots] (TimeSlot): Given a service is selected When the client taps an open day chip Then that day becomes selected and its time slots are loaded
- [Closed or fully booked days are not pressable] (TimeSlot): Given a day is closed or fully booked When the day strip is displayed Then that day is grey and pressing it has no effect
- [Past days are not shown] (TimeSlot): Given today is a given date When the day strip is built Then no day earlier than today is offered
- [Slot offered only if full duration fits] (TimeSlot): Given a service of duration D and a day with opening hours When a candidate start time would end after closing or overlap a taken slot Then that start time is not offered
- [Slot that is too short for service is greyed] (TimeSlot): Given a selected service whose duration does not fit a start time When the time grid is displayed Then that slot is grey, struck through and not pressable
- [Time slot grid layout] (TimeSlot): Given free slots exist for a day When the grid is displayed Then it has three columns and the selected slot is plum filled with white text
- [No-times message for a day without free slots] (TimeSlot): Given a chosen day has no free slot for the service When step 3 is displayed Then a grey no-times message replaces the grid
- [Taken slot status is one-way] (TimeSlot): Given a time slot is taken When any later action is applied to it Then its status remains taken
- [Free slot becomes taken on booking] (TimeSlot): Given a time slot is free When a booking is created on it Then the slot status becomes taken
- [Taken slots cannot be selected] (TimeSlot): Given a time slot is taken When the client presses it Then the press is ignored and the current selection is unchanged
- [Selecting a free slot] (Booking): Given free slot A is selected When the client taps free slot B Then slot B becomes the selected slot
- [Client name is required and limited] (Booking): Given the client enters a name When the name is empty or longer than 80 characters Then the name is rejected with a red message; a name of 1 to 80 characters is accepted
- [Phone format and length] (Booking): Given the client enters a phone When it contains letters or other symbols or has fewer than 7 or more than 15 digits Then it is rejected; otherwise it is accepted
- [Email must be valid and required] (Booking): Given the client enters an email When it is empty or not a valid address Then it is rejected; a valid address is accepted
- [Fields validate when left] (Booking): Given the client has typed an invalid value in a field When the field loses focus Then the field shows a red outline and a red message below it
- [Invalid fields block submission] (Booking): Given at least one contact field is invalid When the client attempts to submit Then no booking is created and the invalid fields show red messages
- [Book button enabled only when all valid] (Booking): Given any of service, slot or contact details is missing or invalid When the form is displayed Then the Request booking button is grey and disabled
- [Sending state on submit] (Booking): Given the client has submitted a valid booking When the request is in progress Then the button label reads Sending
- [New booking starts as requested] (Booking): Given all details are valid and the slot is free When the client submits Then the booking is created with status requested
- [One booking per slot] (Booking): Given a submission has already created a booking for a slot When the same submission is sent again or another client submits for that slot Then no second booking is created for that slot
- [Slot taken meanwhile refuses submission] (Booking): Given the chosen slot became taken after selection When the client submits Then no booking is created, the slot is greyed out, a message asks for another time, and the contact details remain filled in
- [Submission failure banner] (Booking): Given the submission fails for a reason other than a taken slot When the response arrives Then a red-tinted failure banner with the message is shown above the button
- [Confirmation panel after successful submit] (Booking): Given a booking was created When the submission succeeds Then the form is replaced by a confirmation panel with a green tick, the booking summary and a status pill
- [Status pill displays booking status] (Booking): Given a booking has status requested or confirmed When the confirmation panel is shown Then the pill reads Requested in amber or Confirmed in green accordingly
- [Requested to confirmed by salon only] (Booking): Given a booking has status requested When salon staff confirm it outside the interface Then its status becomes confirmed
- [Client cannot change booking status] (Booking): Given a booking has status confirmed or requested When the client interacts with the confirmation panel Then no action changes the booking status
- [Book another resets to step 1] (Booking): Given the confirmation panel is shown When the client taps Book another Then the form returns to step 1 with no service, day, slot or details selected
- [Completed step heading scrolls back] (Booking): Given a step is completed When the client taps its heading Then the page scrolls to that step
- [Booking summary shows selections] (Booking): Given a service, day and slot are selected When the summary is displayed Then it shows the service name, day, start time and duration
- [Page layout and palette] (Service): Given the booking page is loaded When it is rendered Then content is a 640px centred column on warm off-white with the specified heading styles
intent_block:
- Product type: customer_app
- Audience: Hair salon clients booking appointments
- Goal: Let clients see available appointment times and book a hair salon service without phoning the salon.
- Scope: A single booking page where clients choose a service and time slot and submit their contact details to create a booking.
- The model must cover: Services offered and their durations; Available appointment time slots; Client booking requests with contact details; Booking status (requested or confirmed)
- Do NOT model: Staff rosters and stylist assignment; Online payments and deposits; Inventory and product sales; Client loyalty programmes
